Module.Title: PF2E Affliction Forge: Curses & Damnations
Module.LibraryDescription: Original curses and damnations with semantic Creature Forge tags.
Module.SyncFailed: Curses & Damnations could not synchronize its library. See console.

candle-shadow-jinx.Name: Candle-Shadow Jinx
candle-shadow-jinx.Description: A petty shadow curse makes edges of light slip and hands tremble at exactly the wrong moment.

crooked-luck-hex.Name: Crooked-Luck Hex
crooked-luck-hex.Description: A common hex makes confident thoughts stumble and small coincidences turn against the victim.

grave-whisper.Name: Grave Whisper
grave-whisper.Description: The voice of a restless dead lingers in the back of the mind and draws warmth from the body.

thorn-oath.Name: Thorn Oath
thorn-oath.Description: A broken fey oath grows unseen thorns beneath the skin.

mirrors-spite.Name: Mirror’s Spite
mirrors-spite.Description: A cursed reflection gradually steals clarity, orientation, and trust in one’s own senses.

moonless-mark.Name: Moonless Mark
moonless-mark.Description: A black mark chills in moonlight and makes the world around the victim feel threateningly wrong.

hollow-name.Name: Hollow Name
hollow-name.Description: The curse gnaws at the meaning of the victim’s own name until words become difficult to force from the mouth.

feystep-snare.Name: Feystep Snare
feystep-snare.Description: Invisible paths of the First World knot around the victim’s steps and pull every movement out of rhythm.

ashen-vow.Name: Ashen Vow
ashen-vow.Description: A corrupted vow settles like ash over muscle and vitality.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Enfeebled 1 and drained 1; damage caused by the curse can’t be healed.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Enfeebled 2 and drained 1; healing is blocked.

carrion-bell-curse.Name: Carrion Bell Curse
carrion-bell-curse.Description: Only the victim hears a distant funeral bell whose toll draws closer with every hour.

blood-debt.Name: Blood Debt
blood-debt.Description: Magically bound blood reminds the body of an unpaid debt and prevents vitality from fully returning.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 2d6 void damage and drained 1; can’t be reduced below 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 3d6 void damage and drained 2; can’t be reduced below 2.

sleepless-lantern.Name: Sleepless Lantern
sleepless-lantern.Description: The light of a cursed lantern remains visible behind closed eyes and wears down mind and body.

wolf-moon-oath.Name: Wolf-Moon Oath
wolf-moon-oath.Description: An ancient hunting curse twists posture and instinct until the victim moves like harried prey.

drowned-breath.Name: Drowned Breath
drowned-breath.Description: The curse of the drowned fills the lungs with cold memory instead of water.

black-feather-omen.Name: Black Feather Omen
black-feather-omen.Description: Black feathers appear in dreams and omens until every choice tastes of approaching disaster.

puppets-thread.Name: Puppet’s Thread
puppets-thread.Description: Invisible strings tug at limbs and thoughts as though a distant puppeteer were practicing.

graveglass-gaze.Name: Graveglass Gaze
graveglass-gaze.Description: Death magic lays a layer of cold graveglass over the eyes and then over the mind behind them.

ember-brand.Name: Ember Brand
ember-brand.Description: A brand of elemental ember flares repeatedly and weakens the flesh.

thorn-crown.Name: Thorn Crown
thorn-crown.Description: Invisible thorns press into brow and thought, threading pain through every attempt to focus.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 2d6 persistent bleed damage, stupefied 1, and sickened 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 2d6 persistent bleed damage, stupefied 2, and sickened 2.

dream-eaters-kiss.Name: Dream-Eater’s Kiss
dream-eaters-kiss.Description: Something alien feeds on memories night after night, leaving only exhaustion and blank spaces.

hollow-saints-rebuke.Name: Hollow Saint’s Rebuke
hollow-saints-rebuke.Description: A distorted divine rebuke turns every act of concentration into a struggle against inner accusation.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 4d6 spirit damage and stupefied 2; concentrate actions require a DC 5 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 5d6 spirit damage, stupefied 2, and slowed 1; concentrate actions require a DC 7 flat check.

iron-promise.Name: Iron Promise
iron-promise.Description: A broken pact becomes invisible chains that force strength and vitality beneath their weight.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Enfeebled 2 and drained 1; drained can’t be reduced below 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Enfeebled 2, drained 2, and slowed 1; drained can’t be reduced below 2.

shadow-twin.Name: Shadow Twin
shadow-twin.Description: The victim’s shadow develops a second will and whispers false movements and memories.

starless-benediction.Name: Starless Benediction
starless-benediction.Description: A blessing from a starless sky replaces comfort with cold emptiness and disrupts focused magic.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 5d6 void damage and stupefied 2; concentrate actions require a DC 7 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 6d6 void damage, stupefied 3, and slowed 1; concentrate actions require a DC 9 flat check.

fiends-tithe.Name: Fiend’s Tithe
fiends-tithe.Description: An infernal claim draws vitality from the victim in fixed installments, as though collecting a debt.

Stage1.Name: Stage 1
Stage1.Description: 4d6 void damage and drained 1; can’t be reduced below 1.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 6d6 void damage and drained 2; can’t be reduced below 2.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 8d6 void damage, drained 2, and doomed 1; both conditions are locked.

ancestors-wrath.Name: Ancestor’s Wrath
ancestors-wrath.Description: Dishonored ancestors follow the victim and strike back through dreams, memories, and spirit.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 9d6 spirit damage, frightened 2, stupefied 2, and doomed 1; doomed can’t be reduced below 1.

pale-kings-decree.Name: Pale King’s Decree
pale-kings-decree.Description: An undead sovereign pronounces a sentence that slowly forces the body into the stillness of his court.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 9d6 void damage, drained 2, slowed 2, and doomed 1; conditions are locked.

worldscar-curse.Name: Worldscar Curse
worldscar-curse.Description: Planar scars spread across flesh and soul, forcing the body into contradictory forms.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 10d6 spirit damage, clumsy 2, enfeebled 2, and slowed 1.

eclipse-brand.Name: Eclipse Brand
eclipse-brand.Description: A brand of eclipsed holy light consumes sight and hope together.

Stage1.Name: Stage 1
Stage1.Description: 6d6 void damage, 3d6 mental damage, and dazzled.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 8d6 void damage, 4d6 mental damage, blinded, and stupefied 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 10d6 void damage, 5d6 mental damage, blinded, stupefied 2, and doomed 1; doomed is locked.

doomclock.Name: Doomclock
doomclock.Description: An impossible clock counts down not time, but the victim’s remaining possibilities.

throne-of-ash.Name: Throne of Ash
throne-of-ash.Description: A curse of royal damnation sends furnace heat and grave-cold through the veins at once.

Stage1.Name: Stage 1
Stage1.Description: 7d6 fire damage, 5d6 void damage, and drained 1.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 9d6 fire damage, 6d6 void damage, drained 2, and frightened 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 11d6 fire damage, 7d6 void damage, drained 2, frightened 2, and doomed 1.

last-name-unwritten.Name: The Last Name Unwritten
last-name-unwritten.Description: A curse from a reality beyond names erases first voice, then memory, and finally the bond between soul and world.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 10d6 mental damage, 6d6 void damage, and stupefied 3; speaking is blocked.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 12d6 mental damage, 8d6 void damage, stupefied 3, and doomed 2; speaking is blocked and doomed is locked.

Stage4.Name: Stage 4
Stage4.Description: 14d6 mental damage, 10d6 void damage, and a death effect; speaking is blocked.
